name: Iceland
nis2_law: Act 78/2019 (Lög um net- og upplýsingaöryggi) + 2025 amendment
comment_methodological_notes: Iceland is an isolated grid — ZERO cross-border interconnects. Renderer + dno-dashboard must handle empty cross_border_lines arrays gracefully. Display '0 MW (isolated grid)' rather than '—' or 'no data'.

Iceland is ~99.97% renewable (70.5% hydro + 29.4% geothermal + 0.1% fossil). T_share saturates near 1.0; T1 DER stress modifier loses dynamic range; documented in methodology.html. T1 demand-side variability is dominated by aluminum smelter contracts (long-term baseload with hour-scale curtailment).

ISO 9223 C5 corrosion class is RESTORED for Iceland (first since SI Obalno-kraška). C5 applies to: Reykjanes peninsula (Suðurnes — marine + volcanic H₂S emissions); Vestfirðir (Westfjords — marine coastal exposure); Suðurland geothermal corridor (Hellisheiði/Nesjavellir H₂S).

R6_volcanic is a NEW sub-pattern introduced for Iceland — distinct from R6_seismic. Active eruption cycle on Reykjanes peninsula (Suðurnes) since 19 Mar 2021. 8 Feb 2024 Sundhnúkur eruption damaged Svartsengi geothermal plant infrastructure; Grindavík remains evacuated.

R6c_jokulhlaup is a NEW sub-pattern — glacial-outburst-flood mechanism distinct from Q100 fluvial flood. Sub-glacial volcanic activity (Vatnajökull / Mýrdalsjökull / Eyjafjallajökull) melts ice within a glacier; water accumulates in sub-glacial lake; bursts as flash flood. Anchor events: 1996 Skeiðará (Vatnajökull / Grímsvötn), 2010 Eyjafjallajökull (Markarfljót), 2011 Grímsvötn.
Iceland has NO nuclear power, NO research reactors. R6_nuclear is not applicable. First country in cohort with no nuclear footprint.

Currency is ISK (Icelandic króna) with post-symbol convention ('5,000 kr.' not 'kr. 5,000'). Carries forward HU 'Ft' post-symbol pattern via Safe.fmt. Iceland is the SECOND non-eurozone country in our onboarding queue.

Veðurstofa Íslands (Iceland Met Office) consolidates meteorology + hydrology + seismology + volcanology in one agency (unique in cohort). Single d03_imo ingestion module covers what required 3-4 modules in CEE-South.

r7_methodology.ceiling_rationale: Mid-cohort between SI 1.04 and SK 1.03. CERT-IS founded 2013 (later than SI-CERT 1995, SK-CERT 2009, HU GovCERT 2008) but Iceland DESI proxies + fiber penetration >99% + digital-government adoption ~95% justify the higher ceiling. NIS2 transposed via 2025 amendment to Act 78/2019.
